items.source: Reads the given input stream into an ObjectNode and applies that to the given existing instance.
items.translation: 将给定的输入流读取为 `ObjectNode`，并将其应用于给定的现有实例。

items.source: Reads the given source node onto the given target object and applies PUT semantics, i.e. explicitly
items.translation: 将给定的源节点读取到给定的目标对象上，并应用 PUT 语义，即显式地

items.source: Component to apply an ObjectNode to an existing domain object. This is effectively a best-effort workaround for Jackson's inability to apply a (partial) JSON document to an existing object in a deeply nested way. We manually detect nested objects, lookup the original value and apply the merge recursively.
items.translation: 用于将 ObjectNode 应用到现有领域对象的组件。这实际上是对 Jackson 无法以深层嵌套方式将（部分）JSON 文档应用到现有对象的一种尽力而为的变通方案。我们手动检测嵌套对象，查找原始值并递归地应用合并操作。

items.source: Oliver Gierke, Mark Paluch, Craig Andrews, Mathias Düsterhöft, Thomas Mrozinski, Lars Vierbergen
